text: Ponatinib is a potent, multi-targeted tyrosine kinase inhibitor designed with an alkyne linker that allows it to bind to the ABL1 kinase domain regardless of the presence of the "gatekeeper" T315I mutation. Unlike earlier-generation TKIs that rely on hydrogen bonding—which is disrupted by the substitution of threonine with isoleucine at position 315—ponatinib’s structure avoids steric hindrance and maintains high-affinity binding to the mutated BCR::ABL1 protein [PMID: 41696976]. Clinical evidence confirms that ponatinib retains robust activity across various BCR::ABL1 variants, including T315I, making it a critical therapeutic option for patients with refractory CML [PMID: 41027807]. While newer agents like olverembatinib also target this mutation, ponatinib remains a foundational standard for overcoming TKI-resistance driven by the T315I mutation [PMID: 40438114].
